content: STRM export is the standard mechanism by which Kodi cloud-drive addons get their content into the Kodi video library (posters, fanart, NFO scrapes, watched state, resume, Up Next). plugin.googledrive advertises Export your videos to your library (.strm files); music export is documented as written but not usable because Kodi does not support strm in the music library. The export design in clouddrive.common pairs a per-drive export definition, a scheduled ExportService, and delta change tokens so the strm tree is re-synced when the remote drive changes. Playback of an exported strm re-enters the plugin, and the addon then looks the item up in the library (find_exported_video_in_library) to recover dbid/dbtype and resume position - i.e. resume/watched-state sync is architecturally downstream of export, not independent of it.
